test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A hollow spherical shell is made of a metal of density 6 g/cm³. Its internal and external radii are 8 cm and 9 cm, respectively. What is the weight (in kg) of the shell (take pi = {22 over7})?
solution:
**Given:**

The density of the hollow spherical shells is 6 g/cm³.

Internal Radii (r) is 8 cm and External Radii (R) is 9 cm.

**Formula:**

Weight of the shell = 4over3 piR³- r³ times Density

**Calculation: **

 ⇒4over3pi(9)³-(8)³ times 6 

⇒ 4over3times 22over7(729- 512) times 6 

⇒ 4over3 times 22over 7(217) times 6

⇒ 4over3 times 22over7 times1302

⇒4over3 times 4092

⇒ 5456g

**The weight of the shell is ' 5.456 Kg'.**
